description: Copy-surface registry for the copy lint in docs/v5/market-safety.md (section 文案 lint), read by tools/v5-copy-lint.mjs. Contract fields register themselves in public-v2.yaml with `x-panshi-copy-surface: <kind>` (on a property, or on a schema to cover every string under it); this file holds the kind table, the one exception the market-safety document allows and the only place it may be used, the surfaces the one-character slice does not serve yet, the front-end scan scope, and the schema-name guard that makes a future surface of that kind register before it can ship. The blocked-word list itself is deliberately NOT restated here: the lint reads it from the fenced code block in the market-safety document's 文案 lint section and fails closed if that block is missing or empty. The character-level glyph fold (simplified / Japanese / variant forms onto the list's own characters) lives in the lint source and holds no words.

headline.description: Titles and lead lines: the world story-hook label (今日五幕), the close-up identity line, verb phrase and unresolved-tension sentence, the archive's long-term tension sentence, and the headline of every planned surface. Checked whether or not the value is ticker-specific (stricter than the market-safety document, which names ticker-specific titles). Never exception-eligible: a title is the line most easily lifted off its screen.

notification.description: Push, in-app and email notification copy. Checked on every value; never exception-eligible, because a notification pulls one line out of the screen it came from.

paywall.description: Paywall and Pro-offer copy. Checked on every value; never exception-eligible.

share.description: Share-card copy, headline and body alike. Checked on every value; never exception-eligible, because a share card is a line lifted out of the journal by definition.

short_video.description: 9:16 short-video titles, caption lines and burned-in text. The market-safety document groups these with share cards; checked on every value and never exception-eligible.

alt_text.description: Accessible alternative text (alt, aria-label, altText fields). Checked on every value; never exception-eligible.

sse_event.description: Every string in a server-sent world event frame. A frame only signals that a resource changed, so it has no business carrying market words at all.

caption.description: Secondary visible lines on the world, close-up and archive index (focus hint, attention label, consequence summaries, section summaries, recent highlights). Checked when ticker-specific: the object or its document carries instrumentLabel / instrumentId, or the value names a fixture instrument. Never exception-eligible: none of these is a life-journal post-close review.

journal_review_body.description: Body text of a character life journal's post-close review of a paper action that is already final: the review sentence, its simulation label, original reason and consequence. The only kind the lint lets the registry mark exception-eligible, and only on a planned type that fixes sourceContext to the review context. Checked on every value.

frontend_static.description: Every string literal, static template part and JSX text containing a CJK character in the front-end sources, whatever element, prop or function it ends up in. A static literal cannot carry the four same-screen facts, so it is never exception-eligible.

exception.description: The market-safety document allows the quoted terms in the paragraph after the word list (紙上 + a listed word) only while a character life journal reviews an already-final paper action after the close, on the same screen as time, the simulation label, the original reason and the consequence, and never pulled out as a call to action. The lint reads the allowed terms from that paragraph. Here it only fixes where the term may appear and where the four same-screen facts must be found: in a journal_review_body field (the lint refuses any other kind marked eligible) of an object that declares the journal post-close review context and carries the four facts itself. Headlines, notifications, paywalls, share cards (headline and body), short videos, alt text, SSE frames, CTA fields and front-end literals never take it. Missing any one fact blocks the term like any other listed word.

life_journal_review.description: A life-journal block that reviews one final paper action after the close. Registered so the document's single exception has exactly one home; the served slice renders its journal through LifeJournalEntry, which this lint does not register (outside the document's list).

frontend.note: Every non-test .ts / .tsx file under the roots. Excluded, matched against the repo-relative path: *.test.ts(x), declaration files, test helpers under testing/, and the generated-v2 client. Every string literal, static template part and JSX text that contains a CJK character is checked, whatever element or prop renders it; adjacent static JSX children and + chains of literals are also checked joined. Module specifiers are skipped. No front-end literal is ever exception-eligible.

copyReview: This file holds no display copy. 紙上 and 模擬 above are matching rules, not product text; the English descriptions are engineering notes (未經 copy-taste 審稿).
